user.title: PV plant
user.description: Einspeisewacht tracks feed-in that is not remunerated because of negative day-ahead prices (§ 51 EEG). The values are a guide only – your grid operator's statement is what counts.

data_description.power_kw: Module capacity in kWp. Plants on the same building commissioned within 12 months count together (§ 24 EEG).
data_description.smart_meter: A smart meter gateway from the metering point operator. A digital meter without gateway (modern metering device) does not count.
data_description.smart_meter_date: Plants below 100 kW lose remuneration only from 1 January of the year after the installation.

tier_rates.description: Enter the rate of each band. Einspeisewacht weights them by the share of capacity in each band.

summary.title: Rule

data.backfill_smard: Count earlier negative quarter hours from SMARD.de

data_description.backfill_smard: Over the internet, from SMARD.de (Bundesnetzagentur, CC BY 4.0): once the day-ahead prices since commissioning, so that the extension (§ 51a EEG) also covers the time before setup – and prices that the price sensor leaves open for more than an hour. Without it, counting starts now.

smard_failed.title: SMARD.de unreachable ({name})
smard_failed.description:
Einspeisewacht could not load earlier day-ahead prices from SMARD.de to count the quarter hours before setup. Live counting and booking are not affected. The next start of Home Assistant tries again.

Error: {error}

price_missing.title: No price for the current quarter hour ({name})
price_missing.description: The price sensor {entity} has not delivered a price for the running quarter hour for more than an hour. Einspeisewacht holds the feed-in back for up to 24 hours and books it as soon as the price arrives; after that it counts as remunerated. Check the price integration. This message disappears by itself once prices arrive again. With the SMARD.de option, Einspeisewacht uses the day-ahead prices from SMARD.de in the meantime.

meter_unit.title: Meter unit not supported ({name})
meter_unit.description: The feed-in meter {entity} reports “{unit}”. Einspeisewacht needs Wh, kWh or MWh and does not book anything until then. Choose another meter under Reconfigure, or fix the unit of the sensor.

report.name: Report
report.description: Feed-in, revenue and lost revenue for a period, computed from the meter's long-term statistics (hourly values spread over the quarter hours) and the negative quarter hours known to Einspeisewacht. Also covers the time before setup if the meter's statistics reach back that far.

end.name: To
end.description: Last day of the period (included). Default: today.

import_statistics.name: Import statistics
import_statistics.description: Fills the long-term statistics of the four total sensors (feed-in remunerated/not remunerated, revenue, lost revenue) for the time before setup, from the given day on – computed like the report from the meter's hourly statistics. Later sums are shifted so the series stays continuous. Changes the statistics database: make a backup first. Only hours before each sensor's first statistic are written; a second call finds nothing left.

start.name: From
start.description: First day to fill in, e.g. 1 January or the commissioning date.

entry_not_found.message: This entry does not belong to Einspeisewacht.

entry_not_loaded.message: The plant is not loaded. Check it under Settings → Devices & services.

end_before_start.message: The end of the period is before its start.

empty_period.message: The period contains no complete hour since commissioning.

import_entities_missing.message: The total sensors of this plant were not found.

import_no_statistics_yet.message: The total sensors have no statistics yet. Home Assistant compiles them every hour – try again in an hour.

import_start_after_setup.message: The start must be before the setup of this entry – from then on the sensors have their own statistics. Choose an earlier day.

import_nothing_to_import.message: Nothing to fill in: the statistics already reach back to this day.

import_prices_missing.message: Prices are unknown for {count} quarter hours of this period. Turn on “Count earlier negative quarter hours from SMARD.de” under Reconfigure, wait for it to finish and try again.
